description: Manifest of xUnit + Pester .tmpl files emitted into each generated wrapper's tests/<TestProjectName>/ directory. The api-wrapper-scaffold codegen pipeline (scripts/tests-emit.js) substitutes the tokens below and emits one ClientTests.<Group>.cs per resource group (with [Fact] bodies injected via the {{Facts}} token). Tests in .github/agents/tests/tests-templates.Tests.ps1 enforce manifest <-> body parity.

tokens.ProjectName: PascalCase wrapper name, e.g. ExampleEx. Matches the wrapper csproj.
tokens.Namespace: Root .NET namespace of the wrapper, e.g. Example. Test code lives under {Namespace}.Tests.
tokens.Facts: Pre-rendered block of [Fact] methods (emitted by tests-emit.js per resource group). Empty string in manifest-parity tests.
tokens.ExpectedMethods: Multi-line PowerShell string literal list of generated method names (e.g. '        "GetMeAsync",'). Baked into Mcp.Tests.ps1 so the smoke suite knows exactly which tools to expect.
